userName.description: Name of user who executed the statement

dbName.description: Name of database in which the statement was executed

totalTimeMillis.description: Total time spent in the statement, in milliseconds

numRows.description: Total number of rows retrieved or affected by the statement

numSharedBlkCacheHits.description: Total number of shared block cache hits by the statement

numSharedBlksRead.description: Total number of shared blocks read by the statement

numSharedBlksDirtied.description: Total number of shared blocks dirtied by the statement

numSharedBlksWritten.description: Total number of shared blocks written by the statement

numLocalBlksHit.description: Total number of local block cache hits by the statement

numLocalBlksRead.description: Total number of local blocks read by the statement

numLocalBlksDirtied.description: Total number of local blocks dirtied by the statement

numLocalBlksWritten.description: Total number of local blocks written by the statement

numTempBlksRead.description: Total number of temp blocks read by the statement

numTmpBlksWritten.description: Total number of temp blocks written by the statement

blkReadTimeMillis.description: Total time the statement spent reading blocks, in milliseconds (if track_io_timing is enabled, otherwise zero)

blkWriteTimeMillis.description: Total time the statement spent writing blocks, in milliseconds (if track_io_timing is enabled, otherwise zero)
